author: stahlleiton
body:
#### PR description:

This PR enables the new heavy-ion dedicated egamma regressions in the 2023, 2024 and 2025 Run3_pp_on_PbPb eras and  standardizes the Run3_pp_on_PbPb eras across all years.

The global tags used were defined in https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/request-of-new-mc-gt-for-131x-141x-and-151x/148065/5 .

@mandrenguyen 

#### PR validation:

Tested with worflows 141.401,142.401,143.401,144.401,141.202,142.202,143.202,144.202,159.02,159.03,160.02,160.03,160.401,161.02,161.03,162.02,162.03,163.02,163.03

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

No backport foreseen
title: Add HIN egamma regression to Run3_pp_on_PbPb eras
